# rt/str

> Strings: slicing, searching, splitting, joining, quoting, numbers, and a string builder.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/str.pkg)

Strings are immutable: these functions return new strings and never
change their arguments. A string is a pointer to a `qword` length, the
bytes, and a zero byte (so it also works as a C string).

```
let s = str_concat("pack", "enger")
print str_slice(s, 0, 4)               // pack
print str_find(s, "eng", 0)            // 4
print str_from_int(-42)                // -42

let b = sb_new()
sb_add(b, "x = ")
sb_int(b, 7)
print sb_str(b)                        // x = 7
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `str_alloc(n: int) -> str` | a new string of `n` zero bytes, to fill in through `cstr` before sharing it |
| `str_from(p: ptr u8, n: int) -> str` | copy `n` bytes into a new string |
| `str_slice(s: str, start: int, stop: int) -> str` | the bytes from `start` up to (not including) `stop`, clamped to the string |
| `str_concat(a: str, b: str) -> str` | `a` followed by `b` |
| `str_starts(s: str, prefix: str) -> bool` | does `s` begin with `prefix` |
| `str_ends(s: str, suffix: str) -> bool` | does `s` end with `suffix` |
| `str_find(s: str, sub: str, from: int) -> int` | first index of `sub` at or after `from`, or -1 |
| `str_find_byte(s: str, c: u8, from: int) -> int` | first index of byte `c` at or after `from`, or -1 |
| `str_cmp(a: str, b: str) -> int` | negative, zero or positive, comparing bytes |
| `str_hash(s: str) -> int` | FNV-1a hash of the bytes |
| `str_from_int(n: int) -> str` | decimal digits, with `-` if negative |
| `str_parse_int(s: str, ok: ptr bool) -> int` | parse an optionally negative decimal; `*ok` is false if `s` isn't one or doesn't fit in an `int` |
| `str_pad(s: str, width: int) -> str` | add spaces on the right up to `width` bytes |
| `str_lpad(s: str, width: int) -> str` | add spaces on the left up to `width` bytes |
| `str_concat3(a, b, c: str) -> str`, `str_concat4(a, b, c, d: str) -> str` | three or four strings, one after another |
| `str_has(s: str, sub: str) -> bool` | does `s` contain `sub` |
| `str_is_space(c: u8) -> bool` | space, tab, newline, carriage return, vertical tab or form feed |
| `str_trim(s: str) -> str` | without whitespace at either end |
| `str_rtrim(s: str, c: u8) -> str` | without any `c` bytes at the end (`str_rtrim(url, '/')`) |
| `str_trim_prefix(s: str, prefix: str) -> str` | `s` without `prefix` if it starts with it, else `s` |
| `str_replace(s: str, old: str, new: str) -> str` | every `old` replaced by `new` (`s` itself if `old` is empty) |
| `str_split(s: str, c: u8) -> ptr Vec` | the pieces between `c` bytes, empty ones included: `"a,,b"` gives `a`, ``, `b` |
| `str_fields(s: str) -> ptr Vec` | the pieces between runs of whitespace, none empty |
| `str_join(v: ptr Vec, sep: str) -> str` | the strings in `v` with `sep` between them |
| `str_join_from(v: ptr Vec, from: int, sep: str) -> str` | the same, from item `from` on |
| `str_quote(s: str) -> str` | in double quotes, with `"`, `\\`, `\n`, `\t`, `\r` and other control bytes escaped (`\x01`); other bytes kept as they are |

The `Vec`s that `str_split` and `str_fields` return, and that `str_join`
takes, hold `str`s: read them with `vec_get_str` from
[rt/vec](vec.md).

The builder (`StrBuf`) collects pieces and makes one string at the end:
`sb_new()`, `sb_add(b, s)`, `sb_bytes(b, p, n)`, `sb_byte(b, c)`, `sb_int(b, n)`,
`sb_hex(b, n)` (one byte as two lowercase hex digits), `sb_len(b)`,
`sb_str(b) -> str` (a copy) and `sb_clear(b)`.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
fn str_alloc(n: int) -> str
  let p = mem_alloc(n + 9)
  *(p as ptr int) = n
  return p as str
end

fn str_from(p: ptr u8, n: int) -> str
  let s = str_alloc(n)
  mem_copy(cstr(s), p, n)
  return s
end

fn str_slice(s: str, start: int, stop: int) -> str
  if start < 0
    start = 0
  end
  if stop > len(s)
    stop = len(s)
  end
  if stop <= start
    return ""
  end
  return str_from(mem_add(cstr(s), start), stop - start)
end

fn str_concat(a: str, b: str) -> str
  let s = str_alloc(len(a) + len(b))
  mem_copy(cstr(s), cstr(a), len(a))
  mem_copy(mem_add(cstr(s), len(a)), cstr(b), len(b))
  return s
end

fn str_starts(s: str, prefix: str) -> bool
  return len(prefix) <= len(s) && mem_eq(cstr(s), cstr(prefix), len(prefix))
end

fn str_ends(s: str, suffix: str) -> bool
  let at = len(s) - len(suffix)
  return at >= 0 && mem_eq(mem_add(cstr(s), at), cstr(suffix), len(suffix))
end

fn str_find(s: str, sub: str, from: int) -> int
  if from < 0
    from = 0
  end
  let last = len(s) - len(sub)
  let i = from
  while i <= last
    if mem_eq(mem_add(cstr(s), i), cstr(sub), len(sub))
      return i
    end
  next
    i = i + 1
  end
  return -1
end

fn str_find_byte(s: str, c: u8, from: int) -> int
  if from < 0
    from = 0
  end
  let i = from
  while i < len(s)
    if s[i] == c
      return i
    end
  next
    i = i + 1
  end
  return -1
end

fn str_cmp(a: str, b: str) -> int
  let n = len(a)
  if len(b) < n
    n = len(b)
  end
  for i = 0 to n - 1
    if a[i] != b[i]
      return (a[i] as int) - (b[i] as int)
    end
  end
  return len(a) - len(b)
end

fn str_hash(s: str) -> int
  let h = -3750763034362895579
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    h = (h ^ (s[i] as int)) * 1099511628211
  end
  return h
end

fn str_from_int(n: int) -> str
  if n == 0
    return "0"
  end
  let buf = mem_alloc(24)
  let i = 24
  let m = n
  while m != 0
    let d = m % 10
    if d < 0
      d = -d
    end
    i = i - 1
    *mem_add(buf, i) = (48 + d) as u8
    m = m / 10
  end
  if n < 0
    i = i - 1
    *mem_add(buf, i) = '-'
  end
  return str_from(mem_add(buf, i), 24 - i)
end

fn str_parse_int(s: str, ok: ptr bool) -> int
  let i = 0
  let neg = false
  if len(s) > 0 && s[0] == '-'
    neg = true
    i = 1
  end
  if i >= len(s)
    *ok = false
    return 0
  end
  // accumulate negatively, so the most negative value fits
  let n = 0
  let min = -9223372036854775807 - 1
  while i < len(s)
    let c = s[i]
    if c < '0' || c > '9'
      *ok = false
      return 0
    end
    let d = (c as int) - 48
    if n < (min + d) / 10
      *ok = false
      return 0
    end
    n = n * 10 - d
  next
    i = i + 1
  end
  if !neg && n == min
    *ok = false
    return 0
  end
  *ok = true
  if neg
    return n
  end
  return -n
end

fn str_pad(s: str, width: int) -> str
  if len(s) >= width
    return s
  end
  let out = str_alloc(width)
  mem_copy(cstr(out), cstr(s), len(s))
  mem_set(mem_add(cstr(out), len(s)), ' ', width - len(s))
  return out
end

fn str_lpad(s: str, width: int) -> str
  if len(s) >= width
    return s
  end
  let out = str_alloc(width)
  mem_set(cstr(out), ' ', width - len(s))
  mem_copy(mem_add(cstr(out), width - len(s)), cstr(s), len(s))
  return out
end

struct StrBuf
  data: ptr u8
  len: int
  cap: int
end

fn sb_new() -> ptr StrBuf
  let b = new StrBuf
  b.cap = 64
  b.data = mem_alloc(b.cap)
  return b
end

fn sb_reserve(b: ptr StrBuf, more: int)
  if b.len + more <= b.cap
    return
  end
  let cap = b.cap * 2
  while cap < b.len + more
    cap = cap * 2
  end
  let data = mem_alloc(cap)
  mem_copy(data, b.data, b.len)
  b.data = data
  b.cap = cap
end

fn sb_add(b: ptr StrBuf, s: str)
  sb_reserve(b, len(s))
  mem_copy(mem_add(b.data, b.len), cstr(s), len(s))
  b.len = b.len + len(s)
end

fn sb_bytes(b: ptr StrBuf, p: ptr u8, n: int)
  sb_reserve(b, n)
  mem_copy(mem_add(b.data, b.len), p, n)
  b.len = b.len + n
end

fn sb_byte(b: ptr StrBuf, c: u8)
  sb_reserve(b, 1)
  *mem_add(b.data, b.len) = c
  b.len = b.len + 1
end

fn sb_int(b: ptr StrBuf, n: int)
  sb_add(b, str_from_int(n))
end

fn sb_len(b: ptr StrBuf) -> int
  return b.len
end

fn sb_str(b: ptr StrBuf) -> str
  return str_from(b.data, b.len)
end

fn sb_clear(b: ptr StrBuf)
  b.len = 0
end

fn sb_hex(b: ptr StrBuf, n: int)
  let digits = "0123456789abcdef"
  sb_byte(b, digits[(n >> 4) & 15])
  sb_byte(b, digits[n & 15])
end

fn str_concat3(a: str, b: str, c: str) -> str
  return str_concat(str_concat(a, b), c)
end

fn str_concat4(a: str, b: str, c: str, d: str) -> str
  return str_concat(str_concat(a, b), str_concat(c, d))
end

fn str_has(s: str, sub: str) -> bool
  return str_find(s, sub, 0) >= 0
end

fn str_is_space(c: u8) -> bool
  return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == 11 as u8 || c == 12 as u8
end

fn str_trim(s: str) -> str
  let a = 0
  let b = len(s)
  while a < b && str_is_space(s[a])
    a = a + 1
  end
  while b > a && str_is_space(s[b - 1])
    b = b - 1
  end
  if a == 0 && b == len(s)
    return s
  end
  return str_slice(s, a, b)
end

fn str_rtrim(s: str, c: u8) -> str
  let b = len(s)
  while b > 0 && s[b - 1] == c
    b = b - 1
  end
  return str_slice(s, 0, b)
end

fn str_trim_prefix(s: str, prefix: str) -> str
  if str_starts(s, prefix)
    return str_slice(s, len(prefix), len(s))
  end
  return s
end

fn str_replace(s: str, old: str, rep: str) -> str
  if len(old) == 0
    return s
  end
  let b = sb_new()
  let i = 0
  while true
    let j = str_find(s, old, i)
    if j < 0
      break
    end
    sb_add(b, str_slice(s, i, j))
    sb_add(b, rep)
    i = j + len(old)
  end
  sb_add(b, str_slice(s, i, len(s)))
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn str_split(s: str, c: u8) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let start = 0
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    if s[i] == c
      vec_push(out, str_slice(s, start, i) as int)
      start = i + 1
    end
  end
  vec_push(out, str_slice(s, start, len(s)) as int)
  return out
end

fn str_fields(s: str) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let i = 0
  while i < len(s)
    while i < len(s) && str_is_space(s[i])
      i = i + 1
    end
    let start = i
    while i < len(s) && !str_is_space(s[i])
      i = i + 1
    end
    if i > start
      vec_push(out, str_slice(s, start, i) as int)
    end
  end
  return out
end

fn str_join_from(v: ptr Vec, from: int, sep: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = from to vec_len(v) - 1
    if i > from
      sb_add(b, sep)
    end
    sb_add(b, vec_get(v, i) as str)
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn str_join(v: ptr Vec, sep: str) -> str
  return str_join_from(v, 0, sep)
end

fn str_quote(s: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    let c = s[i]
    if c == '"'
      sb_add(b, "\\\"")
    elif c == '\\'
      sb_add(b, "\\\\")
    elif c == '\n'
      sb_add(b, "\\n")
    elif c == '\t'
      sb_add(b, "\\t")
    elif c == '\r'
      sb_add(b, "\\r")
    elif c < ' ' || c == 127 as u8
      sb_add(b, "\\x")
      sb_hex(b, c as int)
    else
      sb_byte(b, c)
    end
  end
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  return sb_str(b)
end
```
